rca_of_issue.bug: Alert.alert() is completely non-functional on Expo Web / react-native-web
rca_of_issue.root_cause: react-native-web intentionally implements Alert as a stub: `class Alert { static alert() {} }` (source: /app/frontend/node_modules/react-native-web/src/exports/Alert/index.js). The method body is empty — no-op.
rca_of_issue.affected_code: spot-me.tsx toggleJoin function (lines 186-207): uses Alert.alert() for the 'Quitter cette communauté ?' confirmation, Alert.alert for offline error (line 182-183), and catch blocks Alert.alert for API errors (lines 199-201).
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Replace Alert.alert() in toggleJoin with ConfirmActionModal (already used in toggleGoing for the same screen). Pattern already exists in spot-me.tsx — setConfirmAction + setPendingCallback + setConfirmVisible. Also, replace Alert.alert for error messages with a toast or inline error display.
rca_of_issue.reproduction: 1. Login as user@winek.app, 2. Navigate to /spot-me, 3. Click Communautés tab, 4. Click 'Quitter' button — nothing happens
